To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the microstructure of LF6 aluminum alloy presents zonal distribution and the dynamic recrystalization and the dynamic recovery occur during hot working process.
the microstructure of LF6 is zonal distribution and the grain size increases with the increasing of deformation levels.

The microstructures present zonally distribution and become obvious along with the increasing the deformation levels, during hot working process, dynamic recovery, dynamic recrystallsation occur in the microstructures, the grain size grows up accompany the temperature raising.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the microstructure evolution during deformation process of aluminum alloy LF6.
the microstructure evolution of LF6 alloy in the hot deformation process, and the relationship between the deformation process and microstructure of LF6 alloy.

the relationship between the microstructure of LF6 and its heat deformation process, and it can provide the theoretical basis for the hot-working technology and the design of the hot-working parameters of the LF6 alloy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the microstructure of LF6 alloy is closely related with the deformation processes.
the hot-working deformation process of LF6 alloy has great influence on its microstructure.
the microstructural evolution of LF6 alloy during hot deformation is a result of the combined effects of dynamic recrystalling, dynamic recovery and grain growth.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the deformation mechanism of aluminum alloy LF6 is the combination of dynamic recovery and dynamic re-crystallization, and the microstructure of the aluminum alloy LF6 changes with the temperature and strain.
the grain sizes increase with the increasing deformation level, but the grain size decreases as the temperature rising.
the microstructure of LF6 alloy is mainly controlled by dynamic recrystallsization and dynamic recovery during hot deformation process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the grain growth rate of the alloy LF6 in the deformation process is higher than the growth rate of the crystal grains in the nondeformation process.
the microstructure is sensitive to the deformation process.
the deformation process and the microstructure of LF6 are related to each other.
